items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: I was thinking that it was always, that all jazz musicians were the way that they were portrayed by Mezz Mezzrow.

ctx.x: Sometimes it is, but not always.
No but I was thinking that it was always, that all jazz musicians were the way that they were portrayed by Mezz Mezzrow. And it’s not so.

Right. You seem to make a good pair. And I know over the twenty years you’ve had quite a significant hand in Bob’s career. Did you, when you first got into trying to further his career, was it a steep learning process for you, of how to negotiate contracts and how to open avenues? How to get him in other parts of the world that he hadn’t been in before?
